title: Feedback for each wrong option
statement: Give each wrong option its own feedback that names the error and likely misconception it stands for and says what to look at next.
example: In one course draft, none of the 1,234 option-specific feedback routes fell back to a generic message keyed to the option's position.
detail: A review of one grade 5 course draft was closed with all 1,234 option-specific feedback routes having zero generic option-position IDs or truncated claim and recheck templates. The reading project's evaluator gap list asks for misconception-coded distractors and misconception-named feedback, and its course checklist requires every scored item to carry correct and incorrect feedback, with each wrong option mapped to a named misconception. One message for every wrong answer, generic encouragement or feedback keyed to an option's position is a defect.
against: The same rubric requires feedback to state the correct answer or clearly guide the student to it (`icloud-work/inceptbench/submodules/reading-question-qc/qc_pipeline/config/prompts.json`, L77), which conflicts with feedback that sends the student back. The record shows the gate's result, not a case where feedback keyed to a position reached a student.
